items.title: Amazon devices chief Panos Panay on the importance of failure and bouncing back from it
items.summary: Panay said that it's possible to recover and learn from all sorts of failures, even catastrophic ones, when building products.
items.creator: Aisha Malik

items.title: Meta launches an open-weight AI model that runs on Macs
items.summary: Meta and Apple have teamed up for the launch of the social media giant's newest model, Muse Spark Open, which will run locally on Apple silicon.
items.creator: Lucas Ropek
